set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('app/src/main/java/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/shizuku/ShizukuUserServiceProbe.java')
s=p.read_text()
pattern=r'    private final Runnable timeout = \(\) -> finish\(\n.*?\n    \);\n'
replacement='''    private final Runnable timeout = () -> finish(
        probeName() + "\nerror=connect_timeout"
    );
'''
s2,n=re.subn(pattern,replacement,s,count=1,flags=re.S)
if n != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'timeout regex replacements={n}')
anchor='    private void start() {\n'
insert='''    private String probeName() {
        return live ? "probe=shizuku-user-service-live-v1" : "probe=shizuku-user-service-v1";
    }

'''
if s2.count(anchor) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'start anchors={s2.count(anchor)}')
s2=s2.replace(anchor,insert+anchor,1)
p.write_text(s2)
PY
